errors.text_span: Третият(оранжев) и четвъртият дял(син) са 16,7 % общо
errors.evidence: This is about the reference, not the machine text. The machine description does not mention the combined 16.7% for the orange and blue sectors, which is acceptable as those percentages are not labeled in the figure. No error here on this point.

The reference mentions that the third (orange) sector has a larger share compared to the fourth (blue) sector among the two that together make 16.7%. The machine description does note the orange is third and blue is smallest, so this is captured, but the combined 16.7% total for these two sectors is not mentioned.
